scope.game_date_rule: Date parsed from the NBA Kalshi game ticker (scheduled game date).
scope.requested_window: last 10 minutes before each market's recorded close_time; close-10m < trade timestamp <= close
scope.markets: both team YES markets when available; market-YES price and settlement outcome
scope.trade_unit: trade rows, not contract quantity; block trades excluded; resolved markets only; regular-season postgame archive reused and missing playoff postgame rows fetched from the public Kalshi historical-trades endpoint
scope.all_price_count_rule: No price-band restriction; all recorded prices retained for the count and after-last-play share.
scope.prelec_price_rule: Same phase5a pipeline: one-cent bins, trade-weighted calibration; raw and isotonic two-parameter Prelec-II fits. Prices exactly 0 or 1 are omitted from the curve fit only, if present.
scope.longshot_gap_rule: A = p - Y for market-YES trades with 5c <= p <= 20c, pooled equally across trade rows.
scope.gap_interval: 2,000 percentile bootstrap draws resampling games and recomputing the pooled trade-row mean.

longshot_pooled_gap.bootstrap_cluster: game; pooled trade-row mean recomputed in each resample
